meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装好后,你想报 LazyCodex 或 Codex CLI 的 bug 时,Claude 会调查、核对源码,把根因、复现步骤和修复建议整理成 GitHub issue(或 PR),自动路由到正确仓库并打标签。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发。尤其当需要源码级根因和修复指引时。

say.text: 把 LazyCodex 安装器这个报错整理成 GitHub issue。
say.note: 会先调查,再生成带复现步骤的 issue。

say.text: 给 openai/codex 提交一个 PR 修复这个配置加载问题。
查一下这个 Codex 崩溃有没有已存在的 issue,没有就建一个。
say.note: 会先搜索现有 issue,避免重复提交。

howto.what_en: When asked to report a LazyCodex/Codex CLI bug, Claude investigates, checks both repos' sources, and creates a structured GitHub issue/PR with root cause, reproduction steps, and fix guidance, routed to the right repo.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to report, file, or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when source-backed root cause and fix guidance are needed.

say_en.text: File this LazyCodex installer error as a GitHub issue.
say_en.note: Investigates first, then creates an issue with repro steps.

say_en.text: Create a PR in openai/codex fixing this config loading problem.
say_en.note: Only for openai/codex and when you ask for a PR.

say_en.text: Check if this Codex crash already has an issue; if not, create one.
say_en.note: Searches existing issues to avoid duplicates.
